Course Numbering System

Courses numbered 001 to 099 may not be used to meet graduation requirements.

The chart indicates the general numeric range for the respective class standings:

FRESHMAN

100 to 199

SOPHOMORE

200 to 299

JUNIOR

300 to 399

SENIOR

400 to 499

Graduate (paired with Undergraduate*)

500 to 599

Graduate
Courses numbered 600 to 699 are exclusively for graduate students.

600 to 699

Courses numbered 700 to 795 are exclusively for graduate students

Doctoral

700 to 795

800 to 899

*Courses numbered 500 to 599 are double-numbered courses (with courses in the 400 to 499 series) and are open to graduate students.
